subject: Request: Pilot window padding due to third-party SDK embargo
messages:
From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@kilncloud.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 7 Apr 2027 15:03:00 +0000
Subject: Pilot timeline — SDK embargo causing delay

Hi Aisha,

Quick update from our engineering side — the third‑party payments SDK we depend on shipped a breaking change this week and their maintainers have put an embargo on the public patch while they push a backwards‑compatibility fix. Our integration tests are failing on token negotiation (see attached test snippet) and the team has paused work until the upstream patch lands.

We had the customer demo scheduled for Apr 14 and internal sign‑offs tied to that date; given this blocker, we are asking whether Redwood can: 1) extend our pilot window to give us time to rework the adapter once the SDK patch is cut, and 2) provide a small sandbox credit top‑up so our engineers can spin up extra environments for parallel testing.

Impact summary:
- Current pilot end: Apr 30
- Ask: extend to May 31 (one month extra)
- Requested sandbox tokens: +50,000 tokens (one‑time)
- Reason: parallel QA + mitigation work while waiting on upstream fix

I'm attaching a short test log and a trace of the failing handshake. We appreciate any runway you can provide — this pilot is strategic for us.

Thanks,
Sanjay Rao
Director of Engineering
KilnCloud
Attachments: handshake_trace.log (text/plain), integ-test-failure.txt (text/plain)

From: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@kilncloud.com>
Cc: Marta Ruiz <marta@kilncloud.com>
Date: Wed, 7 Apr 2027 17:10:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Pilot timeline — SDK embargo causing delay

Hi Sanjay — thanks for the clear summary and for sending the logs.

I’m sorry to hear about the SDK embargo — that’s rough timing. I’ll escalate internally and see what runway and credits we can offer as a one‑time accommodation for KLN‑487. Two quick asks so I can move this forward with finance/onboarding:

1) Can you confirm the minimal demo date you still want to aim for (is moving the demo to Apr 28 acceptable?), and
2) a brief note about whether the +50k tokens covers parallel QA needs or if you want them staged across two environments.

I’ll loop in our onboarding lead and the finance approver for a fast decision. Expect an update from me within 24 hours.

Best,
Aisha Rahman
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415‑555‑0167

From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 8 Apr 2027 09:05:00 +0000
Subject: INTERNAL: Pilot extension request — KilnCloud (KLN‑487)

Lauren —

Quick internal note on KLN‑487: engineering reviewed the logs Aisha attached and agrees the failure is clearly upstream. From a product/support perspective we should grant a finite extension + one‑time sandbox top‑up to preserve momentum. Proposed concession: extend pilot to 2027‑05‑31 and allocate 50,000 tokens to their sandbox (non‑refundable, single use).

Rationale: low cost, high chance to convert (deal at evaluation); avoids losing demo window that’s critical for exec buy‑in.

If you approve, I’ll draft the short MOU and coordinate with Marissa for onboarding support.

– Dev

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>
To: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwoodinference.com>, Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 8 Apr 2027 11:20:00 +0000
Subject: Re: INTERNAL: Pilot extension request — KilnCloud (KLN‑487)

Thanks Dev — I’m fine with the concession as described (extend to 2027‑05‑31, +50k sandbox tokens). Please make sure the credit is limited to their sandbox project ID and that it's a one‑time top‑up. Marissa, please prepare an onboarding checklist and estimate of hours if they need hands‑on support.

Aisha — you have approval to proceed; send them the MOU and DocuSign link and loop in finance if they want the credits to appear on a revised pilot SOW.

Lauren Bishop
Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@kilncloud.com>
Cc: Marta Ruiz <marta@kilncloud.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 13:30:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Pilot timeline — SDK embargo causing delay

Sanjay — good news: we can accommodate a one‑time pilot extension and sandbox top‑up. Summary of what’s approved:

- Extension: pilot end date moved from 2027‑04‑30 to 2027‑05‑31 (30 extra days)
- Sandbox credit: one‑time +50,000 tokens applied to your sandbox project ID (non‑refundable, single allocation)
- Conditions: credits are limited to testing environments only; we’ll revoke any misuse per standard terms.

Next steps (quick):
1) I attached the one‑page MOU for the extension (pilot_extension_mou.pdf — stub). Please review and sign via DocuSign: https://docsend.com/kilncloud/pilot-mou
2) Send the sandbox project ID you want the credits applied to and whether you want them staged across two environments or a single bucket.
3) Proposed new demo: Apr 28 (if that works for your team); otherwise pick a date before May 20 so Marissa's onboarding can assist.

Attachments: pilot_extension_mou.pdf (application/pdf), sandbox_credit_notes.txt (text/plain)

If you want, Marissa will schedule a short pairing session with our onboarding engineer to help parallelize tests.

Thanks — we’re looking forward to keeping the momentum going.

Best,
Aisha Rahman
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 415‑555‑0167
Redwood Inference — helping teams serve LLMs in production
